description.value: Ocean Trails Resort is a 78-unit self-contained condo resort spread across seven wooded acres immediately adjacent to Rathtrevor Beach in Parksville, rated #1 specialty lodging in Parksville on TripAdvisor. Suites range from one to three bedrooms and come with fully equipped kitchens, private entrances, and free parking, making extended stays practical. The surrounding Parksville–Qualicum Beach region offers cycling-friendly terrain including beach trails, provincial parks, and routes toward Englishman River Falls and Mount Arrowsmith.
